items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Picou I said man I was with Picou three weeks before he died.

ctx.x: Well I’m really happy that we had this conversation and you know the wisdom that you’ve acquired in your years both in education and in playing really comes through.

Well and that’s what I want it to do. And you know the main thing about it, there’s some people I see say, “man, you still teaching school? If I had all the years you had I’d have been retired a long time ago. I say, “man I enjoy what I’m doing.” I didn’t go to school to sell insurance. I haven’t practiced all my life to sell cars. I didn’t do this to sit in an office and be an executive now. I’m doing it, exactly what I wanted to do. And if Katrina hadn’t come along I wouldn’t have retired. They took the music…
Well I’m going to get a handshake in here, because our tape is about to run out.
